titleFull: About High Society - Elevating Michigan's Cannabis Experience
metaDescription: Learn about High Society's mission to provide exceptional cannabis products, unbeatable prices, and top-tier customer service across our Michigan dispensaries.

blocks.heading: Our Story
blocks.md: Founded in 2020, High Society was created by a group of people looking to bring a different perspective to the industry. The group comes from different backgrounds and industries but has one goal in common: Elevating the cannabis experience with amazing deals and excellent customer service.

blocks.heading: Mission and Vision
blocks.md: Our mission is to put our customers in the best products that match their needs during their visit by asking the right questions and finding that perfect fit! We want to be the leading brand of provisioning centers in Michigan. We offer the largest selection of products from quality vendors, provide the best consumer journey for our guests, and give back to the communities we operate in.

items.title: Hospitality
items.md: We believe strongly in the aspect of providing amazing service to guests that visit our stores. We spend time working with our teams to make sure all of our staff is trained and knowledgeable to provide you with the highest level of service.

items.title: Quality
items.md: We strive to bring only premium high-quality products into our stores. We work with trusted vendors to procure products that have passed Michigan’s stringent testing standards.

items.title: Community
items.md: We value the communities we’re a part of. We are always looking for ways to engage and collaborate with our communities through events and partnerships. If you have something you would like us to be a part of, please feel free to [contact us](/contact/).

blocks.heading: Your Trusted Source for Quality Cannabis in Michigan
blocks.md: Visit us to discover why we’re Michigan’s trusted choice for cannabis.
